requirements.title: persistent project understanding

requirements.title: stable project-controlled bootstrap

requirements.title: conversation and model independence

requirements.title: task-shaped safe orientation

requirements.title: progressive disclosure
requirements.mechanism: progressive bootstrap -> view -> semantic source -> evidence drill-down

requirements.title: active route reconstruction
requirements.mechanism: single-source workstream declarations plus generated active route graph

requirements.title: relevant discovery with safety-calibrated recall
requirements.mechanism: exact/structured/lexical/optional semantic retrieval plus generated risk/governance indexes

requirements.title: reconstruction and authority-resolution receipts

requirements.title: known-risk and evolution-trigger activation

requirements.title: uncertainty visibility

requirements.title: multidimensional reconstruction qualification

requirements.title: consequence-sensitive degraded mode

requirements.mechanism: selective effective/authority time plus explicit transition modes only where semantics require them

requirements.title: recurring active-surface consolidation lifecycle
